explication: Plyr is a browser-side accessible media player for HTML5 audio/video and YouTube/Vimeo embeds. Its main workflow is that an integrator initializes a player on media markup, then uses the unified controls and API to play, seek, change settings, and receive standardized events. The map also preserves documented capabilities such as captions, fullscreen, ads, and preview thumbnails. The tree and excerpts establish the entry point, plugin files, and some feature behavior; wiring among unsampled modules is shown only where supported by the documented workflow.
